pain_point: No warehouse stock available in right size
headline_pain: Too Big. Too Old. Too Expensive.
primary_text: "There's literally nothing available to buy in the size range we need in the west." Dozens of small business owners across Melbourne's west have told us the same thing. Everything on the market is oversized, overpriced, or needs a fortune in fitout. That's why these Truganina warehouses were designed from scratch for businesses like yours — practical layouts and sizes that make sense. Not corporate mega-sheds. Real spaces for real businesses. Near Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. See what other owner-occupiers are choosing.
description: Practical layouts and sizes designed from scratch for small businesses
